def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return n distinct record ids, the same list on every run for the same seed.

    Pure and deterministic: it uses no capabilities, no clock and no randomness
    source. The ids come only from seed and n.
    """
    pre n >= 0
    post out.len() == n
    post {x for x in out}.len() == n
    ex make_ids(n=0, seed=5) == []
    ex make_ids(n=3, seed=7).len() == 3
    ex make_ids(n=3, seed=7) == make_ids(n=3, seed=7)
    base = seed % 1000000007
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(base + i)
    return out
